cases.sentence: ___ в то время оставил братьев и поселился у одного человека из Эдулама.
cases.translation: At that time Judah left his brothers and settled near a man from Adullam.
cases.explain: Иуда is the subject of оставил, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Она села у ___ в Инаим, который на дороге в Тимну.
cases.translation: She sat at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah.
cases.explain: The preposition у governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Иуда сказал своей ___ Фамаре, «Живи вдовой в доме у твоего отца».
cases.translation: Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, 'Live as a widow in your father's house.'
cases.explain: The verb сказать takes the person addressed (to whom) in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он изливал семя на ___, чтобы не произвести потомство для брата.
cases.translation: He spilled his seed on the ground, so as not to produce offspring for his brother.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating direction (onto) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Ты должен лечь с ___ брата и исполнить долг.
cases.translation: You must go in to your brother's wife and perform the duty.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning 'together with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Живи вдовой в ___ у твоего отца, пока не вырастет мой сын Шелла.
cases.translation: Live as a widow in your father's house until my son Shelah grows up.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Иуда в то время оставил братьев и поселился у одного человека из Эдулама по имени Хира.
reading.question: What did Judah do at that time regarding his brothers?
options: He left his brothers and settled near a man named Hirah
He sent his brothers to Egypt
reading.correct: He left his brothers and settled near a man named Hirah
reading.explain: The text says Judah 'оставил братьев и поселился у одного человека... по имени Хира' (left his brothers and settled near a man named Hirah).

reading.ru: Иуда взял для своего первенца Ира жену по имени Фомарь.
reading.question: Who did Judah take as a wife for his firstborn son Er?
reading.explain: The text says Judah took 'жену по имени Фомарь' (a wife named Tamar) for Er.

reading.ru: Но Ир, Иудин первенец, был грешен в глазах Господа, и Господь предал его смерти.
reading.question: What happened to Er, Judah's firstborn?
options: The Lord put him to death for his wickedness
reading.correct: The Lord put him to death for his wickedness
reading.explain: The text says Er 'был грешен в глазах Господа, и Господь предал его смерти' (was wicked in the Lord's sight, and the Lord put him to death).

reading.ru: Тогда Иуда сказал своей невестке Фамаре, «Живи вдовой в доме у твоего отца, пока не вырастет мой сын Шелла».
reading.question: What did Judah tell Tamar to do after Onan's death?
options: Live as a widow in her father's house until Shelah grew up
reading.correct: Live as a widow in her father's house until Shelah grew up
reading.explain: Judah tells Tamar 'Живи вдовой в доме у твоего отца, пока не вырастет мой сын Шелла' (live as a widow in your father's house until my son Shelah grows up).

reading.ru: Она сняла вдовьи одежды, покрылась накидкой, чтобы ее не узнали, и села у входа в Инаим
reading.question: What did Tamar do to disguise herself before meeting Judah?
options: She took off her widow's clothes and covered herself with a veil
reading.correct: She took off her widow's clothes and covered herself with a veil
reading.explain: The text says she 'сняла вдовьи одежды, покрылась накидкой, чтобы ее не узнали' (took off her widow's clothes and covered herself with a veil so she would not be recognized).

reading.ru: Она ответила, «Твою печать на шнурке и посох, который у тебя в руке».
reading.question: What pledge did Tamar ask Judah for?
reading.explain: Tamar answers 'Твою печать на шнурке и посох' (your seal on the cord, and your staff).

reading.ru: Иуда сказал, «Выведите ее, и пусть она будет сожжена».
reading.question: What did Judah initially order be done to Tamar when he heard she was pregnant?
options: That she be brought out and burned
That she be sent away quietly
reading.correct: That she be brought out and burned
reading.explain: Judah says 'Выведите ее, и пусть она будет сожжена' (bring her out, and let her be burned).

reading.ru: Иуда узнал их и сказал, «Она правее, чем я, потому что я не отдал ее за моего сына Шеллу, и он больше не ложился с ней».
reading.question: What did Judah admit when he recognized the seal, cord, and staff?
options: That Tamar was more righteous than he was
That Shelah had lied to him
reading.correct: That Tamar was more righteous than he was
reading.explain: Judah says 'Она правее, чем я' (she is more righteous than I).

reading.ru: Затем вышел и тот, у которого на запястье была алая нить, и ему дали имя Зирах.
reading.question: What was the second twin, who had the scarlet thread on his wrist, named?
reading.explain: The text says the one with the scarlet thread on his wrist 'ему дали имя Зирах' (was given the name Zerah).
